pages.text: You get better at things by doing them. There are 12 skills: Mining, Foraging, Farming, Fishing, Cooking, Crafting, Attack, Range, Defense, Agility, Magic and Taming. Each level up to 50 gives a point to spend in that skill's tree. Press $(l)K$() to open the skill menu.

Trees have five tiers. Spending points in a tree opens the next tier (5, 10, 15, then 25 points). Tiers marked $(l)OR$() let you pick one of two branches. Hover a node to see what it does now (white) and what the next rank adds (grey). A full tree costs exactly 50 points.
pages.title: Skill Trees

pages.text: $(l)/fotfskills perks$() lists every perk you have. Situational buffs (forests, combat, full hunger...) show beside your inventory when active.$(br2)$(l)/fotfskills levelups off$() hides level-up messages; $(l)on$() brings them back.
pages.title: Perks

pages.text: Your $(l)total level$() (all 12 skills added up) gives extra hearts and ParCool stamina: the first at total level 8, all 15 by 256.$(br2)$(l)/fotfskills reset <tree>$() gives a tree's points back for 1 XP level per 2 points spent (at least 5).
pages.title: Hearts & Resets

pages.text: Place a $(l)Pet Bed$() and let your pet walk onto it once: if it dies, it comes back at its bed the next morning (someone has to be nearby at sunrise).$(br2)Taming's $(l)Soul Mender$() gives a chance that a pet survives a killing blow on full health.
pages.title: Pets
